## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      15 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 27 jul 2026 - 26 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Go bubble yourself_, 26 ago 2026, 1/5: "Racist HOLLY ON YOUR CHAT TRYING TO SABOTAGE MY ACCOUNT - CUSTOMER SUPPORT ABSOLUTLY RUBBISH App buggy and lagging adverts in the app ?!?!"
            2. _Leadhorse1982_, 24 ago 2026, 1/5: "Zero customer support when submitting tickets, aero transparency with minute totals and app is beyond laggy make it almost unusable."
            3. _Spensnaps_, 24 ago 2026, 1/5: "Absolutely awful customer service, horrific app experience, broken bikes everywhere. DO NOT BOTHER. I have put up with this rubbish app and customer service team for too long. Opening a chat with them is useless, they never come back to you even after several emails, i have lots so much money paying for minutes when the app decides every forest bike is already in use OR they have ‘temporary issues’ OR the bike randomly locks halfway through a journey and i’m unable to end the ride. Their phones lines NEVER work.. even though they say they are temporarily down. I would recommend using any of the other services in London. VOI, LIKE or Santander are all way better value, way better customer service who actually respond and don’t have stupid adds that pop up as you try and end your ride. Ridiculous that forest can class themselves as a company. Absolutely furious. Watch them reply to this review and do absolutely nothing to rectify the issues their users are having."
